async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Search for the article using the searchbox and button in the complementary section
    searchbox = page.get_by_role("searchbox", name="Search")
    await searchbox.fill("Downing Street insists negotiations over US-UK tech deal still live")
    search_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Search")
    await search_button.click()
    # Wait for search results to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("load")
    # Step 2: Find and click the link to the article in the search results
    # Assuming the search results contain links with the article title
    article_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Downing Street insists negotiations over US-UK tech deal still live")
    await article_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("load")
    # Get the current URL to use as page_url for image extraction
    current_url = page.url
    # Extract the relative path from the full URL (assuming base is http://localhost:8000)
    import urllib.parse
    parsed_url = urllib.parse.urlparse(current_url)
    page_url = parsed_url.path + ("?" + parsed_url.query if parsed_url.query else "")
    # Step 3: Call extract_images_from_page_manual to get image metadata
    result = await extract_images_from_page_manual(page, page_url)
    # Step 4: Terminate with the result
    return result
